body.prompt: A minimal Roman coin emblem: a perfect double circle ring, inside it a clean simplified side-profile silhouette of a bearded Roman emperor facing right with a laurel wreath, drawn with few confident lines, iconic and readable at very small sizes, like a modern luxury monogram. Premium luxury brand emblem, flat vector line art, perfectly centered, crisp clean BOLD lines of even medium-thick weight in pure warm ivory white (#F2EBDD) on a plain solid near-black background (#0B0A09), high contrast, large and filling about 80% of the frame, generous but even margins, no gradients, no shading, no texture, no 3D. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark.
